featured.title: Special Ops Remastered
featured.h3_header: Original MW2 Special Ops missions ported to MW2CR!
featured.content_long:
After many months of work, the Special Ops mod for MW2CR is finally finished
It currently supports the following missions:

- The Pit
- Sniper Fi
- O Cristo Redentor
- Evasion
- Body Count
- Bomb Squad
- ... and many more

To install it follow the instructions found here:
^3https://github.com/alicealys/h2-specops-mod^7

featured.title: Survival Remastered
featured.content_long:
This version includes many features and maps: - Added Laststand
- Added support Delta Team
- Added support GIGN Team
- Added riotshield juggernauts
- Added ranks and unlocks
- Added a better loadscreen
- Weapons:
- Added attachments
- Added H1 weapons
- Fixed H2 weapon damage
- UI:
- Added personalization menu
- Gloves/Viewhands
- Starting pistol
- Custom soundtrack
- Added game setup menu:
- Starting wave
- Better map selection
- Added Stats menu
- Added Lobby menu
- Bug fixes
- And more...

featured.title: Palestine Click to Help
featured.content_long:
"Your free click generates donations from our sponsors. Remember, you may click once a day, every day. Donations raised will go to UNRWA to assist the Palestinian refugees":

^3https://arab.org/click-to-help/palestine/^7

Other places to donate:

^3https://arab.org/portal/palestine/where-to-donate/^7

Image source: https://afsc.org/news/6-ways-you-can-support-palestinians-gaza
